properties.markdownProperty:
A **Traceability matrix** is a *computed* view: it has no content of its own, but is generated from the traces in the project when the document is displayed. You configure it with:
- *Source classes (rows)*: the classes of the objects whose traces are analysed, - *Target classes (columns)*: the classes of the objects those traces may point to, - *Trace types*: which kinds of trace to include (by default `:Proteus-dependency`).
Each cell shows whether the row object traces to the column object. Matrices get an automatic code (`TRM-001`, ...) and a Markdown *Description*.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **No**, apart from symbolic links. Its only class is `traceability-matrix`, not `traceable-object`, so no *Dependencies* can point to it, but a symbolic link can show it elsewhere. - *Can have traces to other objects:* **Yes, but only to stakeholders**, through *Authors* and *Sources*. It has no *Dependencies*. Its class and trace-type lists are configuration settings, not traces.
